def read_text(path: Path) -> str:
    return path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")


def write_text(path: Path, text: str) -> None:
    path.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")


def run_command(args: list[str]) -> None:
    print("RUN " + " ".join(args))
    completed = subprocess.run(args, cwd=str(ROOT), check=False)
    if completed.returncode != 0:
        raise SystemExit(completed.returncode)


def extract_all(path: Path) -> list[str]:
    tree = ast.parse(read_text(path), filename=str(path))
    for node in tree.body:
        if not isinstance(node, ast.Assign):
            continue
        if not any(isinstance(target, ast.Name) and target.id == "__all__" for target in node.targets):
            continue
        if not isinstance(node.value, ast.List):
            return []
        result: list[str] = []
        for item in node.value.elts:
            if isinstance(item, ast.Constant) and isinstance(item.value, str):
                result.append(item.value)
        return result
    return []


def ensure_registry_import() -> None:
    text = read_text(REGISTRY_PATH)
    if "workflow_cross_project_generalization_detectors" in text:
        return

    marker = "from __future__ import annotations\n"
    if marker not in text:
        raise RuntimeError("Could not locate future import in registry.")

    insert_at = text.find(marker) + len(marker)
    text = text[:insert_at] + "\n" + REGISTRY_IMPORT + text[insert_at:]
    write_text(REGISTRY_PATH, text)


def ensure_registry_registration() -> None:
    text = read_text(REGISTRY_PATH)
    if '"workflow_cross_project_generalization"' in text:
        return
    write_text(REGISTRY_PATH, text.rstrip() + "\n" + REGISTRY_APPEND + "\n")


def update_manifest() -> None:
    data = json.loads(read_text(MANIFEST_PATH))
    helpers = data.setdefault("helpers", {})
    helpers["workflow_cross_project_generalization_detectors.py"] = {
        "exports": [
            "detect_workflow_cross_project_generalization_issues",
        ],
        "purpose": "Tab 2 cross-project generalization workflow detector.",
    }

    actual_exports: list[str] = []
    for helper_name in sorted(helpers):
        helper_path = HELP_DIR / helper_name
        if not helper_path.exists():
            raise RuntimeError("Missing helper in manifest: " + helper_name)
        helper_exports = extract_all(helper_path)
        helpers[helper_name]["exports"] = helper_exports
        actual_exports.extend(helper_exports)

    data["exports"] = sorted(actual_exports)
    data["origin_all"] = sorted(extract_all(ORIGIN_PATH))

    public_exports = data.get("public_exports")
    if isinstance(public_exports, list):
        data["public_exports"] = [
            item for item in public_exports
            if item in data["exports"] or item in data["origin_all"]
        ]

    write_text(MANIFEST_PATH, json.dumps(data, indent=2) + "\n")


def main() -> int:
    write_text(DETECTOR_PATH, DETECTOR_SOURCE)
    write_text(TEST_PATH, TEST_SOURCE)

    ensure_registry_import()
    ensure_registry_registration()
    update_manifest()

    run_command([sys.executable, "-m", "py_compile", str(DETECTOR_PATH)])
    run_command([sys.executable, "-m", "py_compile", str(REGISTRY_PATH)])
    run_command([sys.executable, "-m", "py_compile", str(TEST_PATH)])
    run_command([sys.executable, "-m", "json.tool", str(MANIFEST_PATH)])
    run_command([sys.executable, "-m", "unittest", "tests.test_manage_workflows_cross_project_generalization_detectors"])
    run_command([sys.executable, "kanda_reasoner_app/manage_workflows/manage_workflows_validate_manifests.py"])

    print("W020 cross-project generalization detector applied.")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

@'
from __future__ import annotations

import json
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(r"E:\developer_tools")
OUT_DIR = ROOT / "workbench" / "_bundle_temp" / "w021_help_catalog_source"

CANDIDATE_DIRS = [
    ROOT / "kanda_reasoner_app" / "reasoner_tools_gui_help",
    ROOT / "kanda_reasoner_app" / "reasoner_tools_gui_shell",
    ROOT / "kanda_reasoner_app" / "manage_architecture",
    ROOT / "kanda_reasoner_app" / "manage_architecture_help",
    ROOT / "kanda_reasoner_app" / "manage_workflows",
    ROOT / "kanda_reasoner_app" / "manage_workflows" / "manage_workflows_help",
]

TEXT_SUFFIXES = {
    ".py",
    ".json",
    ".md",
    ".txt",
    ".yml",
    ".yaml",
}

HELP_NAME_MARKERS = (
    "help",
    "catalog",
    "tab",
    "architecture",
    "workflow",
    "issue",
    "error",
    "warning",
    "validation",
)

CONTENT_MARKERS = (
    "First step",
    "Second step",
    "check/correct architecture",
    "check/correct workflow",
    "Tab 1",
    "Tab 2",
    "architecture validation",
    "workflow validation",
    "error",
    "warning",
    "issue",
    "detector",
    "help",
)


def read_text(path: Path) -> str:
    return path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")


def is_candidate_file(path: Path) -> bool:
    if path.suffix.lower() not in TEXT_SUFFIXES:
        return False

    lowered_name = path.name.lower()
    lowered_path = str(path.relative_to(ROOT)).replace("\\", "/").lower()

    if any(marker in lowered_name for marker in HELP_NAME_MARKERS):
        return True
    if any(marker in lowered_path for marker in ("help", "gui_shell", "manage_workflows", "manage_architecture")):
        try:
            text = read_text(path)
        except OSError:
            return False
        return any(marker.lower() in text.lower() for marker in CONTENT_MARKERS)
    return False


def iter_candidate_files() -> list[Path]:
    files: list[Path] = []
    seen: set[str] = set()

    for base_dir in CANDIDATE_DIRS:
        if not base_dir.exists():
            continue
        for path in sorted(base_dir.rglob("*")):
            if not path.is_file():
                continue
            try:
                rel = str(path.relative_to(ROOT)).replace("\\", "/")
            except ValueError:
                continue
            if rel in seen:
                continue
            if is_candidate_file(path):
                seen.add(rel)
                files.append(path)

    return files


def number_lines(text: str) -> list[str]:
    lines = text.splitlines()
    return [
        str(index).rjust(5) + ": " + line
        for index, line in enumerate(lines, start=1)
    ]


def write_combined(files: list[Path]) -> Path:
    output: list[str] = []
    output.append("W021 HELP CATALOG SOURCE COLLECTION")
    output.append("ROOT: " + str(ROOT))
    output.append("FILE COUNT: " + str(len(files)))
    output.append("")

    for path in files:
        rel = str(path.relative_to(ROOT)).replace("\\", "/")
        output.append("=" * 90)
        output.append("FILE: " + rel)
        output.append("=" * 90)
        output.append("")

        try:
            text = read_text(path)
        except OSError as exc:
            output.append("READ_ERROR: " + type(exc).__name__ + ": " + str(exc))
            output.append("")
            continue

        output.extend(number_lines(text))
        output.append("")

    out_path = OUT_DIR / "w021_help_files_combined_numbered.txt"
    out_path.write_text("\n".join(output), encoding="utf-8")
    return out_path


def write_index(files: list[Path]) -> Path:
    rows = []
    rows.append("W021 HELP FILE INDEX")
    rows.append("")
    for path in files:
        rel = str(path.relative_to(ROOT)).replace("\\", "/")
        try:
            text = read_text(path)
            line_count = len(text.splitlines())
        except OSError:
            line_count = -1
        rows.append(str(line_count).rjust(6) + " lines  " + rel)

    out_path = OUT_DIR / "w021_help_file_index.txt"
    out_path.write_text("\n".join(rows) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    return out_path


def write_chunks(combined_path: Path, chunk_lines: int = 220) -> Path:
    chunk_dir = OUT_DIR / "chunks"
    chunk_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    text = read_text(combined_path)
    lines = text.splitlines()

    for start in range(0, len(lines), chunk_lines):
        chunk_number = start // chunk_lines + 1
        end = min(start + chunk_lines, len(lines))
        chunk_path = chunk_dir / ("w021_help_chunk_" + str(chunk_number).zfill(3) + ".txt")

        chunk_output = []
        chunk_output.append("W021 HELP SOURCE CHUNK " + str(chunk_number))
        chunk_output.append("LINES " + str(start + 1) + "-" + str(end))
        chunk_output.append("")
        chunk_output.extend(lines[start:end])
        chunk_path.write_text("\n".join(chunk_output) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")

    return chunk_dir


def main() -> int:
    OUT_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    files = iter_candidate_files()
    index_path = write_index(files)
    combined_path = write_combined(files)
    chunk_dir = write_chunks(combined_path)

    print("WROTE " + str(index_path))
    print("WROTE " + str(combined_path))
    print("WROTE CHUNKS " + str(chunk_dir))
    print("")
    print("FIRST COPY/PASTE THIS FILE:")
    print(str(index_path))
    print("")
    print("THEN COPY/PASTE THE COMBINED FILE IF IT IS NOT TOO LARGE:")
    print(str(combined_path))
    print("")
    print("IF TOO LARGE, COPY/PASTE CHUNKS FROM:")
    print(str(chunk_dir))
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

import ast

DETECTOR_SOURCE = '''"""Detect remaining Tab 2 environment and root contract workflow errors."""

from __future__ import annotations

import re
from typing import Any

from .workflow_detector_context import WorkflowDetectorContext
from .workflow_issue_models import WorkflowIssue

__all__ = [
    "detect_workflow_environment_contract_issues",
]

_BAD_ENCODING_MARKERS = (
    "-encoding unicode",
    "-encoding default",
    "-encoding oem",
    "-encoding ascii",
    "encoding='ascii'",
    'encoding="ascii"',
    "encoding='cp1252'",
    'encoding="cp1252"',
    "encoding='mbcs'",
    'encoding="mbcs"',
)

_LINE_ENDING_MARKERS = (
    "line_endings",
    "newline",
    "lineEnding",
    "line_ending",
)

_ALLOWED_LINE_ENDINGS = {
    "lf",
    "crlf",
    "native",
    "preserve",
}

_OUTPUT_KEYS = (
    "expected_outputs",
    "expected_output_files",
    "expected_json_files",
    "outputs",
)

_NON_EMPTY_GUARD_KEYS = (
    "require_non_empty_output",
    "require_non_empty_outputs",
    "non_empty_outputs",
    "expected_stdout_markers",
    "expected_stderr_markers",
    "expected_content_markers",
    "content_markers",
)

_DEPENDENCY_KEYS = (
    "dependencies",
    "required_dependencies",
    "python_dependencies",
    "requires",
)

_PINNED_DEPENDENCY_RE = re.compile(
    r"^[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+\\s*(==|>=|<=|~=|>|<)\\s*[A-Za-z0-9_.!*+-]+$"
)

_WINDOWS_ABSOLUTE_PATH_RE = re.compile(
    r"(?<![A-Za-z0-9_{}])[A-Za-z]:[\\\\/][^\\s\\\"'`<>|]+"
)

_ROOT_PLACEHOLDERS = (
    "{root}",
    "{project_root}",
    "{workspace_root}",
)


def _issue(
    *,
    issue_id: str,
    workflow_step: str,
    evidence: str,
    expected: str,
    actual: str,
) -> WorkflowIssue:
    return WorkflowIssue(
        issue_id=issue_id,
        category="workflow_environment_contract",
        severity="error",
        workflow_step=workflow_step,
        evidence=evidence,
        expected=expected,
        actual=actual,
    )


def _iter_workflow_commands(manifest: dict[str, Any]) -> list[tuple[str, int, Any]]:
    workflows = manifest.get("workflows", {})
    if not isinstance(workflows, dict):
        return []

    items: list[tuple[str, int, Any]] = []
    for workflow_name, workflow_cfg in sorted(workflows.items()):
        if not isinstance(workflow_cfg, dict):
            continue
        if workflow_cfg.get("enabled") is False:
            continue
        commands = workflow_cfg.get("commands") or []
        if not isinstance(commands, list):
            continue
        for index, spec in enumerate(commands, start=1):
            items.append((str(workflow_name), index, spec))
    return items


def _command_name(spec: Any, index: int) -> str:
    if isinstance(spec, dict) and spec.get("name"):
        return str(spec.get("name"))
    return "command_" + str(index)


def _command_text(spec: Any) -> str:
    if isinstance(spec, str):
        return spec
    if not isinstance(spec, dict):
        return ""

    parts: list[str] = []
    command = spec.get("command")
    if command is not None:
        parts.append(str(command))

    args = spec.get("args")
    if isinstance(args, list):
        parts.extend(str(item) for item in args)

    cwd = spec.get("cwd")
    if cwd is not None:
        parts.append(str(cwd))

    return " ".join(parts)


def _dict_text(spec: Any) -> str:
    try:
        return json_dumps_safe(spec)
    except Exception:
        return str(spec)


def json_dumps_safe(value: Any) -> str:
    import json

    return json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=True)


def _has_bad_encoding_marker(text: str) -> str | None:
    lowered = text.lower()
    for marker in _BAD_ENCODING_MARKERS:
        if marker in lowered:
            return marker
    return None


def _bad_line_ending_value(spec: dict[str, Any]) -> tuple[str, str] | None:
    for key in _LINE_ENDING_MARKERS:
        if key not in spec:
            continue
        value = str(spec.get(key)).strip().lower()
        if value and value not in _ALLOWED_LINE_ENDINGS:
            return key, value
    return None


def _has_expected_output_contract(spec: dict[str, Any]) -> bool:
    return any(key in spec for key in _OUTPUT_KEYS)


def _has_non_empty_guard(spec: dict[str, Any]) -> bool:
    for key in _NON_EMPTY_GUARD_KEYS:
        value = spec.get(key)
        if value:
            return True
    return False


def _allows_empty_output(spec: dict[str, Any]) -> bool:
    for key in ("allow_empty_output", "allow_empty_outputs", "success_on_empty_output"):
        if spec.get(key) is True:
            return True
    return False


def _dependency_items(value: Any) -> list[str]:
    if isinstance(value, str):
        return [value]
    if isinstance(value, list):
        return [str(item) for item in value if isinstance(item, str)]
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        return [str(key) + str(val) for key, val in value.items()]
    return []


def _find_unpinned_dependencies(spec: dict[str, Any]) -> list[str]:
    unpinned: list[str] = []
    for key in _DEPENDENCY_KEYS:
        if key not in spec:
            continue
        for item in _dependency_items(spec.get(key)):
            text = item.strip()
            if text and not _PINNED_DEPENDENCY_RE.match(text):
                unpinned.append(text)
    return sorted(set(unpinned))


def _path_root_drift_hits(spec: dict[str, Any]) -> list[str]:
    hits: list[str] = []
    for key in ("cwd", "root", "project_root", "output_root", "cache_root", "workspace_root"):
        if key not in spec:
            continue
        value = str(spec.get(key))
        if any(marker in value for marker in _ROOT_PLACEHOLDERS):
            continue
        for match in _WINDOWS_ABSOLUTE_PATH_RE.finditer(value):
            hits.append(key + "=" + match.group(0))
    return sorted(set(hits))


def detect_workflow_environment_contract_issues(
    context: WorkflowDetectorContext,
) -> list[WorkflowIssue]:
    """Detect remaining Tab 2 help-list workflow environment contract errors."""
    manifest = context.workflow_manifest
    if not isinstance(manifest, dict):
        return []

    issues: list[WorkflowIssue] = []

    for workflow_name, index, spec in _iter_workflow_commands(manifest):
        command_name = _command_name(spec, index)
        workflow_step = workflow_name + "::" + command_name
        text = _command_text(spec)

        bad_encoding = _has_bad_encoding_marker(text)
        if bad_encoding is not None:
            issues.append(
                _issue(
                    issue_id="WORKFLOW_ENCODING_OR_LINE_ENDING_MISMATCH",
                    workflow_step=workflow_step,
                    evidence=bad_encoding,
                    expected="Workflow commands that write or read text should use utf-8 or preserve/native line ending contracts.",
                    actual=text,
                )
            )

        if isinstance(spec, dict):
            bad_line_ending = _bad_line_ending_value(spec)
            if bad_line_ending is not None:
                key, value = bad_line_ending
                issues.append(
                    _issue(
                        issue_id="WORKFLOW_ENCODING_OR_LINE_ENDING_MISMATCH",
                        workflow_step=workflow_step,
                        evidence=key + "=" + value,
                        expected="Allowed line ending contracts are lf, crlf, native, or preserve.",
                        actual=_dict_text(spec),
                    )
                )

            if _allows_empty_output(spec):
                issues.append(
                    _issue(
                        issue_id="WORKFLOW_SILENT_EMPTY_OUTPUT_SUCCESS",
                        workflow_step=workflow_step,
                        evidence="allow_empty_output=true",
                        expected="Workflow success should not explicitly allow empty required outputs.",
                        actual=_dict_text(spec),
                    )
                )
            elif _has_expected_output_contract(spec) and spec.get("require_non_empty_output") is False:
                issues.append(
                    _issue(
                        issue_id="WORKFLOW_SILENT_EMPTY_OUTPUT_SUCCESS",
                        workflow_step=workflow_step,
                        evidence="require_non_empty_output=false",
                        expected="Expected output contracts should require non-empty output or explicit content markers.",
                        actual=_dict_text(spec),
                    )
                )

            unpinned = _find_unpinned_dependencies(spec)
            if unpinned:
                issues.append(
                    _issue(
                        issue_id="WORKFLOW_DEPENDENCY_VERSION_SKEW",
                        workflow_step=workflow_step,
                        evidence=", ".join(unpinned),
                        expected="Declared workflow dependencies should include version constraints such as ==, >=, <=, ~=, >, or <.",
                        actual=_dict_text(spec),
                    )
                )

            root_hits = _path_root_drift_hits(spec)
            if root_hits:
                issues.append(
                    _issue(
                        issue_id="WORKFLOW_PATH_ROOT_DRIFT",
                        workflow_step=workflow_step,
                        evidence=", ".join(root_hits),
                        expected="Workflow root, cwd, output_root, cache_root, and workspace_root should use {root} or project-relative paths.",
                        actual=_dict_text(spec),
                    )
                )

    return issues
'''

TEST_SOURCE = '''"""Focused tests for remaining Tab 2 workflow environment contract detectors."""

from __future__ import annotations

import unittest
from pathlib import Path

from kanda_reasoner_app.manage_workflows.manage_workflows_help.workflow_detector_context import (  # noqa: E501
    WorkflowDetectorContext,
)
from kanda_reasoner_app.manage_workflows.manage_workflows_help.workflow_detector_registry import (  # noqa: E501
    run_workflow_detectors,
)
from kanda_reasoner_app.manage_workflows.manage_workflows_help.workflow_environment_contract_detectors import (  # noqa: E501
    detect_workflow_environment_contract_issues,
)


def _context(command: object) -> WorkflowDetectorContext:
    return WorkflowDetectorContext(
        project_root=Path(".").resolve(),
        workflow_manifest={
            "workflows": {
                "business_checks": {
                    "enabled": True,
                    "commands": [command],
                }
            }
        },
        workflows_doc="",
    )


class WorkflowEnvironmentContractDetectorTests(unittest.TestCase):
    """Protect remaining Tab 2 help-file workflow error contracts."""

    def test_project_relative_utf8_command_is_allowed(self) -> None:
        context = _context(
            {
                "name": "safe_command",
                "args": ["{python}", "tool.py", "--validate"],
                "cwd": "{root}",
                "line_endings": "preserve",
                "dependencies": ["pytest>=8"],
            }
        )

        issues = detect_workflow_environment_contract_issues(context)

        self.assertEqual(issues, [])

    def test_bad_encoding_marker_is_error(self) -> None:
        context = _context(
            {
                "name": "bad_encoding",
                "command": "Set-Content -Path out.txt -Encoding Unicode",
            }
        )

        issues = detect_workflow_environment_contract_issues(context)

        self.assertEqual(len(issues), 1)
        self.assertEqual(
            issues[0].issue_id,
            "WORKFLOW_ENCODING_OR_LINE_ENDING_MISMATCH",
        )

    def test_bad_line_ending_value_is_error(self) -> None:
        context = _context(
            {
                "name": "bad_line_endings",
                "args": ["{python}", "tool.py"],
                "line_endings": "random",
            }
        )

        issues = detect_workflow_environment_contract_issues(context)

        self.assertEqual(len(issues), 1)
        self.assertEqual(
            issues[0].issue_id,
            "WORKFLOW_ENCODING_OR_LINE_ENDING_MISMATCH",
        )

    def test_explicit_empty_output_success_is_error(self) -> None:
        context = _context(
            {
                "name": "empty_success",
                "args": ["{python}", "tool.py"],
                "expected_outputs": ["report.txt"],
                "allow_empty_output": True,
            }
        )

        issues = detect_workflow_environment_contract_issues(context)

        self.assertEqual(len(issues), 1)
        self.assertEqual(
            issues[0].issue_id,
            "WORKFLOW_SILENT_EMPTY_OUTPUT_SUCCESS",
        )

    def test_non_empty_output_guard_false_is_error(self) -> None:
        context = _context(
            {
                "name": "empty_success",
                "args": ["{python}", "tool.py"],
                "expected_outputs": ["report.txt"],
                "require_non_empty_output": False,
            }
        )

        issues = detect_workflow_environment_contract_issues(context)

        self.assertEqual(len(issues), 1)
        self.assertEqual(
            issues[0].issue_id,
            "WORKFLOW_SILENT_EMPTY_OUTPUT_SUCCESS",
        )

    def test_unpinned_dependency_is_error(self) -> None:
        context = _context(
            {
                "name": "dependency_skew",
                "args": ["{python}", "tool.py"],
                "dependencies": ["pytest", "ruff>=0.1"],
            }
        )

        issues = detect_workflow_environment_contract_issues(context)

        self.assertEqual(len(issues), 1)
        self.assertEqual(
            issues[0].issue_id,
            "WORKFLOW_DEPENDENCY_VERSION_SKEW",
        )
        self.assertIn("pytest", issues[0].evidence)

    def test_path_root_drift_is_error(self) -> None:
        context = _context(
            {
                "name": "root_drift",
                "args": ["{python}", "tool.py"],
                "cwd": "E:\\\\developer_tools",
            }
        )

        issues = detect_workflow_environment_contract_issues(context)

        self.assertEqual(len(issues), 1)
        self.assertEqual(issues[0].issue_id, "WORKFLOW_PATH_ROOT_DRIFT")

    def test_default_registry_runs_detector(self) -> None:
        context = _context(
            {
                "name": "dependency_skew",
                "args": ["{python}", "tool.py"],
                "dependencies": ["pytest"],
            }
        )

        issues = run_workflow_detectors(context)

        issue_ids = {issue.issue_id for issue in issues}
        self.assertIn("WORKFLOW_DEPENDENCY_VERSION_SKEW", issue_ids)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(unittest.main())

REGISTRY_IMPORT = '''from .workflow_environment_contract_detectors import (
    detect_workflow_environment_contract_issues,
)
'''

REGISTRY_APPEND = '''
# W021-T2 remaining Tab 2 help parity detector registration.
try:
    register_workflow_detector(
        "workflow_environment_contract",
        detect_workflow_environment_contract_issues,
    )
except ValueError:
    pass
'''


def read_text(path: Path) -> str:
    return path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")


def write_text(path: Path, text: str) -> None:
    path.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")


def run_command(args: list[str]) -> None:
    print("RUN " + " ".join(args))
    completed = subprocess.run(args, cwd=str(ROOT), check=False)
    if completed.returncode != 0:
        raise SystemExit(completed.returncode)


def extract_all(path: Path) -> list[str]:
    tree = ast.parse(read_text(path), filename=str(path))
    for node in tree.body:
        if not isinstance(node, ast.Assign):
            continue
        if not any(isinstance(target, ast.Name) and target.id == "__all__" for target in node.targets):
            continue
        if not isinstance(node.value, ast.List):
            return []
        result: list[str] = []
        for item in node.value.elts:
            if isinstance(item, ast.Constant) and isinstance(item.value, str):
                result.append(item.value)
        return result
    return []


def ensure_registry_import() -> None:
    text = read_text(REGISTRY_PATH)
    if "workflow_environment_contract_detectors" in text:
        return

    marker = "from __future__ import annotations\n"
    if marker not in text:
        raise RuntimeError("Could not locate future import in registry.")

    insert_at = text.find(marker) + len(marker)
    text = text[:insert_at] + "\n" + REGISTRY_IMPORT + text[insert_at:]
    write_text(REGISTRY_PATH, text)


def ensure_registry_registration() -> None:
    text = read_text(REGISTRY_PATH)
    if '"workflow_environment_contract"' in text:
        return
    write_text(REGISTRY_PATH, text.rstrip() + "\n" + REGISTRY_APPEND + "\n")


def update_manifest() -> None:
    data = json.loads(read_text(MANIFEST_PATH))
    helpers = data.setdefault("helpers", {})
    helpers["workflow_environment_contract_detectors.py"] = {
        "exports": [
            "detect_workflow_environment_contract_issues",
        ],
        "purpose": "Tab 2 remaining help parity detector for encoding, empty output, dependency, and path-root contracts.",
    }

    actual_exports: list[str] = []
    for helper_name in sorted(helpers):
        helper_path = HELP_DIR / helper_name
        if not helper_path.exists():
            raise RuntimeError("Missing helper in manifest: " + helper_name)
        helper_exports = extract_all(helper_path)
        helpers[helper_name]["exports"] = helper_exports
        actual_exports.extend(helper_exports)

    data["exports"] = sorted(actual_exports)
    data["origin_all"] = sorted(extract_all(ORIGIN_PATH))

    public_exports = data.get("public_exports")
    if isinstance(public_exports, list):
        data["public_exports"] = [
            item for item in public_exports
            if item in data["exports"] or item in data["origin_all"]
        ]

    write_text(MANIFEST_PATH, json.dumps(data, indent=2) + "\n")


def main() -> int:
    write_text(DETECTOR_PATH, DETECTOR_SOURCE)
    write_text(TEST_PATH, TEST_SOURCE)

    ensure_registry_import()
    ensure_registry_registration()
    update_manifest()

    run_command([sys.executable, "-m", "py_compile", str(DETECTOR_PATH)])
    run_command([sys.executable, "-m", "py_compile", str(REGISTRY_PATH)])
    run_command([sys.executable, "-m", "py_compile", str(TEST_PATH)])
    run_command([sys.executable, "-m", "json.tool", str(MANIFEST_PATH)])
    run_command([sys.executable, "-m", "unittest", "tests.test_manage_workflows_environment_contract_detectors"])
    run_command([sys.executable, "kanda_reasoner_app/manage_workflows/manage_workflows_validate_manifests.py"])

    print("W021-T2 remaining Tab 2 help parity detector applied.")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

import ast
import json
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(r"E:\developer_tools")
HELP_DIR = ROOT / "kanda_reasoner_app" / "manage_workflows" / "manage_workflows_help"
TEST_DIR = ROOT / "tests"
REGISTRY_PATH = HELP_DIR / "workflow_detector_registry.py"

ORIGIN_PATH = ROOT / "kanda_reasoner_app" / "manage_workflows" / "manage_workflows.py"

FILE_RENAMES = [
    (
        HELP_DIR / "workflow_gui_contract_detectors.py",
        HELP_DIR / "workflow_interaction_contract_detectors.py",
    ),
    (
        HELP_DIR / "workflow_local_ai_detectors.py",
        HELP_DIR / "workflow_reader_ai_contract_detectors.py",
    ),
    (
        TEST_DIR / "test_manage_workflows_gui_contract_detectors.py",
        TEST_DIR / "test_manage_workflows_interaction_contract_detectors.py",
    ),
    (
        TEST_DIR / "test_manage_workflows_local_ai_detectors.py",
        TEST_DIR / "test_manage_workflows_reader_ai_contract_detectors.py",
    ),
]

TEXT_PATHS = [
    REGISTRY_PATH,
    MANIFEST_PATH,
    HELP_DIR / "workflow_interaction_contract_detectors.py",
    HELP_DIR / "workflow_reader_ai_contract_detectors.py",
    TEST_DIR / "test_manage_workflows_interaction_contract_detectors.py",
    TEST_DIR / "test_manage_workflows_reader_ai_contract_detectors.py",
]

TEXT_REPLACEMENTS = [
    ("workflow_gui_contract_detectors", "workflow_interaction_contract_detectors"),
    ("workflow_local_ai_detectors", "workflow_reader_ai_contract_detectors"),
    ("test_manage_workflows_gui_contract_detectors", "test_manage_workflows_interaction_contract_detectors"),
    ("test_manage_workflows_local_ai_detectors", "test_manage_workflows_reader_ai_contract_detectors"),
    ("detect_workflow_gui_contract_issues", "detect_workflow_interaction_contract_issues"),
    ("detect_workflow_local_ai_issues", "detect_workflow_reader_ai_contract_issues"),
    ("workflow_gui_contract", "workflow_interaction_contract"),
    ("workflow_local_ai", "workflow_reader_ai_contract"),
    ("WorkflowGuiContract", "WorkflowInteractionContract"),
    ("WorkflowLocalAi", "WorkflowReaderAiContract"),
    ("WORKFLOW_GUI", "WORKFLOW_INTERFACE"),
    ("WORKFLOW_LOCAL_AI", "WORKFLOW_READER_AI"),
    ("GUI", "interface"),
    ("Gui", "Interaction"),

    ("LOCAL_AI", "READER_AI"),
    ("LocalAI", "ReaderAI"),
    ("LocalAi", "ReaderAi"),
    ("local-AI", "reader-AI"),
    ("local AI", "reader AI"),
    ("local_ai", "reader_ai"),
]


def read_text(path: Path) -> str:
    return path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")


def write_text(path: Path, text: str) -> None:
    path.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")


def move_file_once(old_path: Path, new_path: Path) -> None:
    if old_path.exists() and not new_path.exists():
        old_path.rename(new_path)
        print("RENAMED " + str(old_path.relative_to(ROOT)) + " -> " + str(new_path.relative_to(ROOT)))
        return

    if old_path.exists() and new_path.exists():
        old_text = read_text(old_path)
        new_text = read_text(new_path)
        if old_text and old_text != new_text:
            write_text(new_path, old_text)
            print("REPLACED TARGET FROM OLD SOURCE " + str(new_path.relative_to(ROOT)))
        old_path.unlink()
        print("REMOVED OLD " + str(old_path.relative_to(ROOT)))


def apply_text_replacements(path: Path) -> None:
    if not path.exists():
        return
    text = read_text(path)
    updated = text
    for old, new in TEXT_REPLACEMENTS:
        updated = updated.replace(old, new)
    if updated != text:
        write_text(path, updated)
        print("UPDATED " + str(path.relative_to(ROOT)))


def extract_all(path: Path) -> list[str]:
    tree = ast.parse(read_text(path), filename=str(path))
    for node in tree.body:
        if not isinstance(node, ast.Assign):
            continue
        if not any(
            isinstance(target, ast.Name) and target.id == "__all__"
            for target in node.targets
        ):
            continue
        if not isinstance(node.value, ast.List):
            return []
        result: list[str] = []
        for item in node.value.elts:
            if isinstance(item, ast.Constant) and isinstance(item.value, str):
                result.append(item.value)
        return result
    return []


def update_manifest_exports() -> None:
    data = json.loads(read_text(MANIFEST_PATH))
    helpers = data.setdefault("helpers", {})

    old_helper_names = [
        "workflow_gui_contract_detectors.py",
        "workflow_local_ai_detectors.py",
    ]
    for helper_name in old_helper_names:
        helpers.pop(helper_name, None)

    helpers["workflow_interaction_contract_detectors.py"] = {
        "exports": [
            "detect_workflow_interaction_contract_issues",
        ],
        "purpose": "Tab 2 workflow interaction contract detector.",
    }
    helpers["workflow_reader_ai_contract_detectors.py"] = {
        "exports": [
            "detect_workflow_reader_ai_contract_issues",
        ],
        "purpose": "Tab 2 workflow reader AI contract detector.",
    }

    actual_exports: list[str] = []
    missing_helpers: list[str] = []

    for helper_name in sorted(helpers):
        helper_path = HELP_DIR / helper_name
        if not helper_path.exists():
            missing_helpers.append(helper_name)
            continue
        helper_exports = extract_all(helper_path)
        helpers[helper_name]["exports"] = helper_exports
        actual_exports.extend(helper_exports)

    if missing_helpers:
        raise RuntimeError("Missing helper(s) in manifest: " + ", ".join(missing_helpers))

    data["exports"] = sorted(set(actual_exports))
    data["origin_all"] = sorted(extract_all(ORIGIN_PATH))

    public_exports = data.get("public_exports")
    if isinstance(public_exports, list):
        data["public_exports"] = [
            item
            for item in public_exports
            if item in data["exports"] or item in data["origin_all"]
        ]

    write_text(MANIFEST_PATH, json.dumps(data, indent=2) + "\n")


def run_command(args: list[str]) -> None:
    print("RUN " + " ".join(args))
    completed = subprocess.run(args, cwd=str(ROOT), check=False)
    if completed.returncode != 0:
        raise SystemExit(completed.returncode)


def main() -> int:
    for old_path, new_path in FILE_RENAMES:
        move_file_once(old_path, new_path)

    for path in TEXT_PATHS:
        apply_text_replacements(path)

    update_manifest_exports()

    run_command([sys.executable, "-m", "py_compile", str(HELP_DIR / "workflow_interaction_contract_detectors.py")])
    run_command([sys.executable, "-m", "py_compile", str(HELP_DIR / "workflow_reader_ai_contract_detectors.py")])
    run_command([sys.executable, "-m", "py_compile", str(REGISTRY_PATH)])
    run_command([sys.executable, "-m", "py_compile", str(TEST_DIR / "test_manage_workflows_interaction_contract_detectors.py")])
    run_command([sys.executable, "-m", "py_compile", str(TEST_DIR / "test_manage_workflows_reader_ai_contract_detectors.py")])
    run_command([sys.executable, "-m", "json.tool", str(MANIFEST_PATH)])

    run_command([sys.executable, "-m", "unittest", "tests.test_manage_workflows_interaction_contract_detectors"])
    run_command([sys.executable, "-m", "unittest", "tests.test_manage_workflows_reader_ai_contract_detectors"])
    run_command([sys.executable, "kanda_reasoner_app/manage_workflows/manage_workflows_validate_manifests.py"])

    print("W021-T2B detector taxonomy rename applied.")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

import ast

import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

TEST_DIR = ROOT / "tests"

ORIGIN_PATH = ROOT / "kanda_reasoner_app" / "manage_workflows" / "manage_workflows.py"

DETECTOR_SOURCE = '''"""Detect reader AI ask-flow and JSON-track workflow contract issues."""

from __future__ import annotations

from pathlib import Path

from .workflow_detector_context import WorkflowDetectorContext
from .workflow_issue_models import WorkflowIssue

__all__ = [
    "detect_workflow_reader_ai_contract_issues",
]


def _issue(
    *,
    issue_id: str,
    workflow_step: str,
    evidence: str,
    expected: str,
    actual: str,
) -> WorkflowIssue:
    return WorkflowIssue(
        issue_id=issue_id,
        category="workflow_reader_ai_contract",
        severity="error",
        workflow_step=workflow_step,
        evidence=evidence,
        expected=expected,
        actual=actual,
    )


def _read_text(path: Path) -> str:
    try:
        return path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
    except OSError:
        return ""


def _candidate_source_roots(project_root: Path) -> list[Path]:
    package_root = project_root / "kanda_reasoner_app"
    return [
        package_root / "project_reasoner_v10",
        package_root / "manage_workflows",
    ]


def _combined_source_text(project_root: Path) -> str:
    chunks: list[str] = []
    for source_root in _candidate_source_roots(project_root):
        if not source_root.exists():
            continue
        for path in sorted(source_root.rglob("*.py")):
            chunks.append(_read_text(path))
    return "\\n".join(chunks).lower()


def _reader_runtime_markers() -> tuple[str, ...]:
    local_token = "local"
    ai_token = "ai"
    return (
        local_token + " " + ai_token,
        local_token + "_" + ai_token,
        local_token + "-" + ai_token,
        "ask " + local_token + " " + ai_token,
        "ask_" + local_token + "_" + ai_token,
        "complete_" + local_token + "_" + ai_token,
        "developer_tools__complete_" + local_token + "_" + ai_token,
        "reader ai",
        "reader_ai",
    )


def _has_reader_feature(text: str) -> bool:
    return any(marker in text for marker in _reader_runtime_markers())


def _ask_control_is_wired(text: str) -> bool:
    ask_markers = (
        "ask_" + "local" + "_" + "ai",
        "ask " + "local" + " " + "ai",
        "reader_ai",
        "reader ai",
    )
    has_ask_marker = any(marker in text for marker in ask_markers)
    if not has_ask_marker:
        return False

    wiring_markers = (
        "clicked.connect",
        ".connect(",
        "triggered.connect",
        "button",
        "action",
    )
    return any(marker in text for marker in wiring_markers)


def _session_boundary_is_preserved(text: str) -> bool:
    strong_markers = (
        "session_service",
        "ask_session_service",
        "asksessionservice",
        "session service",
    )
    if any(marker in text for marker in strong_markers):
        return True

    return "session" in text and "service" in text and "ask" in text


def _json_track_classifier_is_present(text: str) -> bool:
    local_token = "local"
    ai_token = "ai"

    strong_markers = (
        "complete_" + local_token + "_" + ai_token,
        "developer_tools__complete_" + local_token + "_" + ai_token,
        "json_track",
        "track_classifier",
    )
    if any(marker in text for marker in strong_markers):
        return True

    has_dual_json_terms = (
        "canonical" in text
        and local_token + "_" + ai_token in text
        and "json" in text
    )
    has_classifier_terms = "classif" in text or "track" in text or "route" in text
    return has_dual_json_terms and has_classifier_terms


def detect_workflow_reader_ai_contract_issues(
    context: WorkflowDetectorContext,
) -> list[WorkflowIssue]:
    """Detect reader AI ask-flow and dual-JSON workflow regressions."""
    text = _combined_source_text(context.project_root)
    if not text.strip():
        return []

    if not _has_reader_feature(text):
        return []

    issues: list[WorkflowIssue] = []

    if not _ask_control_is_wired(text):
        issues.append(
            _issue(
                issue_id="WORKFLOW_READER_AI_ASK_BUTTON_NOT_WIRED",
                workflow_step="reader_ai::ask_control",
                evidence="reader AI ask feature markers exist without a visible button/action wiring marker.",
                expected="The reader AI ask control should be wired to an executable ask action.",
                actual="No clicked/connect/action wiring marker was found near the reader AI ask feature.",
            )
        )

    if not _session_boundary_is_preserved(text):
        issues.append(
            _issue(
                issue_id="WORKFLOW_READER_AI_ASK_SESSION_SERVICE_BYPASSED",
                workflow_step="reader_ai::session_boundary",
                evidence="reader AI ask feature markers exist without a visible session-service boundary marker.",
                expected="The reader AI ask flow should preserve the session-service boundary.",
                actual="No session-service marker was found for the reader AI ask feature.",
            )
        )

    if not _json_track_classifier_is_present(text):
        issues.append(
            _issue(
                issue_id="WORKFLOW_READER_AI_JSON_TRACK_CLASSIFIER_MISSING",
                workflow_step="reader_ai::json_track_classifier",
                evidence="reader AI feature markers exist without a visible dual-JSON classifier marker.",
                expected="The workflow should distinguish canonical JSON from reader AI JSON.",
                actual="No dual-JSON track classifier marker was found.",
            )
        )

    return issues
'''

class AskSessionService:
    pass

class ReaderWindow:
    def build(self):
        self.ask_local_ai_button.clicked.connect(self.ask_local_ai)

        session_service = AskSessionService()

        canonical_track = "developer_tools__complete.json"
        return session_service, json_track, canonical_track
"""


def _context(source_text: str) -> WorkflowDetectorContext:
    temp_dir = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
    root = Path(temp_dir.name)
    source_dir = root / "kanda_reasoner_app" / "project_reasoner_v10"
    source_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    source_path = source_dir / "reader_ai_sample.py"

        project_root=root,
        workflow_manifest={"workflows": {}},
        workflows_doc="",
    )
    context._temp_dir = temp_dir  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
    return context


class WorkflowReaderAiContractDetectorTests(unittest.TestCase):
    """Protect reader AI workflow contract detection."""

    def test_project_without_reader_ai_feature_has_no_issue(self) -> None:
        context = _context("def unrelated():\\n    return 'ok'\\n")

        issues = detect_workflow_reader_ai_contract_issues(context)

        issues = detect_workflow_reader_ai_contract_issues(context)

        self.assertIn("WORKFLOW_READER_AI_ASK_BUTTON_NOT_WIRED", issue_ids)

    def test_missing_session_boundary_is_error(self) -> None:
        source = SAFE_SOURCE.replace("class AskSessionService:\\n    pass\\n\\n", "")
        source = source.replace("session_service = AskSessionService()", "session = object()")
        source = source.replace("return session_service, json_track, canonical_track", "return session, json_track, canonical_track")
        context = _context(source)

        issues = detect_workflow_reader_ai_contract_issues(context)

        issue_ids = {issue.issue_id for issue in issues}
        self.assertIn("WORKFLOW_READER_AI_ASK_SESSION_SERVICE_BYPASSED", issue_ids)

    def test_missing_json_track_classifier_is_error(self) -> None:
        source = SAFE_SOURCE.replace(
            'json_track = "developer_tools__complete_local_AI.json"',
            'json_blob = "developer_tools__complete.json"',
        )
        source = source.replace(
            'canonical_track = "developer_tools__complete.json"',
            'canonical_blob = "developer_tools__complete.json"',
        )
        source = source.replace(
            "return session_service, json_track, canonical_track",
            "return session_service, json_blob, canonical_blob",
        )
        context = _context(source)

        issues = detect_workflow_reader_ai_contract_issues(context)

        issue_ids = {issue.issue_id for issue in issues}
        self.assertIn("WORKFLOW_READER_AI_JSON_TRACK_CLASSIFIER_MISSING", issue_ids)

    def test_default_registry_runs_detector(self) -> None:
        source = SAFE_SOURCE.replace(
            "self.ask_local_ai_button.clicked.connect(self.ask_local_ai)",

        )

        issue_ids = {issue.issue_id for issue in issues}
        self.assertIn("WORKFLOW_READER_AI_ASK_BUTTON_NOT_WIRED", issue_ids)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(unittest.main())

            + "    )\n"
            + "except ValueError:\n"
            + "    pass\n"
        )

    write_text(REGISTRY_PATH, text)


def update_manifest() -> None:
    data = json.loads(read_text(MANIFEST_PATH))
    helpers = data.setdefault("helpers", {})

    helpers["workflow_reader_ai_contract_detectors.py"] = {
        "exports": [
            "detect_workflow_reader_ai_contract_issues",
        ],
        "purpose": "Tab 2 workflow reader AI contract detector.",
    }

    actual_exports: list[str] = []
    missing_helpers: list[str] = []
    for helper_name in sorted(helpers):
        helper_path = HELP_DIR / helper_name
        if not helper_path.exists():
            missing_helpers.append(helper_name)
            continue
        helper_exports = extract_all(helper_path)
        helpers[helper_name]["exports"] = helper_exports
        actual_exports.extend(helper_exports)

    if missing_helpers:
        raise RuntimeError("Missing helper(s): " + ", ".join(missing_helpers))

    data["exports"] = sorted(set(actual_exports))
    data["origin_all"] = sorted(extract_all(ORIGIN_PATH))

    public_exports = data.get("public_exports")
    if isinstance(public_exports, list):
        data["public_exports"] = [
            item
            for item in public_exports
            if item in data["exports"] or item in data["origin_all"]
        ]

    write_text(MANIFEST_PATH, json.dumps(data, indent=2) + "\n")

    print("RUN " + " ".join(args))

def read_text(path: Path) -> str:
    return path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")


def write_text(path: Path, text: str) -> None:
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")


def normalize_path(path: Path) -> str:
    return str(path.relative_to(ROOT)).replace("\\", "/")


def load_manage_architecture_source() -> str:
    root_text = str(ROOT)
    if root_text not in sys.path:
        sys.path.insert(0, root_text)

    module_name = (
        "kanda_reasoner_app.manage_architecture."
        "manage_architecture_help.source_loader_private_impl"
    )
    module = importlib.import_module(module_name)
    loader = getattr(module, "load_manage_architecture_source")
    return str(loader())


def implemented_issue_codes(source: str) -> set[str]:
    codes = set(VALIDATION_ISSUE_CODE_RE.findall(source))
    for code in ISSUE_CODE_RE.findall(source):
        if "_" in code and code.isupper():
            if any(marker in code for marker in ("ERROR", "WARNING", "CONTRACT", "BOUNDARY", "SYMBOL", "IMPORT", "PUBLIC", "TEST", "BUNDLE", "ARTIFACT", "MIXED", "STALE", "DEAD", "AI", "PATH", "PACKAGE", "HELPER", "SCAN", "SYNTAX", "MODULE")):
                codes.add(code)
    return codes


def iter_candidate_files() -> list[Path]:
    files: list[Path] = []
    seen: set[str] = set()

    for directory in HELP_CANDIDATE_DIRS:
        if not directory.exists():
            continue
        for path in sorted(directory.rglob("*")):
            if not path.is_file():
                continue
            if path.suffix.lower() not in TEXT_SUFFIXES:
                continue
            rel = normalize_path(path)
            if rel in seen:
                continue
            seen.add(rel)
            files.append(path)

    return files


def looks_like_tab1_help_file(path: Path, text: str) -> bool:
    lowered_name = path.name.lower()
    lowered_text = text.lower()
    rel = normalize_path(path).lower()

    if "tab 1" in lowered_text:
        return True
    if "architecture validation" in lowered_text and "help" in lowered_text:
        return True
    if "first step" in lowered_text and "architecture" in lowered_text:
        return True
    if "architecture" in lowered_name and "help" in lowered_name:
        return True
    if "reasoner_tools_gui_help" in rel and "architecture" in lowered_text:
        return True
    return False


def extract_help_entries(files: list[Path]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    entries: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

    for path in files:
        try:
            text = read_text(path)
        except OSError:
            continue

        if not looks_like_tab1_help_file(path, text):
            continue

        rel = normalize_path(path)
        lines = text.splitlines()

        for index, line in enumerate(lines, start=1):
            stripped = line.strip()
            if not stripped:
                continue

            numbered = NUMBERED_HELP_RE.match(stripped)
            codes = sorted(set(ISSUE_CODE_RE.findall(stripped)))

            if numbered:
                item_number = int(numbered.group(1))
                label = numbered.group(2)
                if 1 <= item_number <= 50:
                    entries.append(
                        {
                            "kind": "numbered",
                            "number": item_number,
                            "label": label,
                            "codes": codes,
                            "file": rel,
                            "line": index,
                            "raw": stripped,
                        }
                    )
                continue

            if codes and any(code in stripped for code in codes):
                entries.append(
                    {
                        "kind": "coded",
                        "number": None,
                        "label": stripped,
                        "codes": codes,
                        "file": rel,
                        "line": index,
                        "raw": stripped,
                    }
                )

    return entries


def text_contains_keywords(entries: list[dict[str, Any]], keywords: list[str]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    hits: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    lowered_keywords = [keyword.lower() for keyword in keywords]
    for entry in entries:
        haystack = str(entry.get("raw") or entry.get("label") or "").lower()
        if any(keyword in haystack for keyword in lowered_keywords):
            hits.append(entry)
    return hits


def audit_expected(entries: list[dict[str, Any]], codes: set[str]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]] = []

    for item in TAB1_EXPECTED:
        mapped_codes = list(item["codes"])
        implemented = [code for code in mapped_codes if code in codes]
        help_hits = text_contains_keywords(entries, list(item["keywords"]))

        status = "MISSING"
        if implemented and help_hits:
            status = "COVERED"
        elif implemented and not help_hits:
            status = "IMPLEMENTED_NO_HELP_HIT"
        elif not implemented and help_hits:
            status = "HELP_ONLY"

        rows.append(
            {
                "id": item["id"],
                "label": item["label"],
                "status": status,
                "mapped_codes": mapped_codes,
                "implemented_codes": implemented,
                "help_hits": help_hits[:5],
            }
        )

    return rows


def format_help_hit(hit: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
    return (
        str(hit.get("file"))
        + ":"
        + str(hit.get("line"))
        + " :: "
        + str(hit.get("raw"))
    )


def write_report(rows: list[dict[str, Any]], codes: set[str], entries: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> Path:
    counts: dict[str, int] = {}
    for row in rows:
        status = str(row["status"])
        counts[status] = counts.get(status, 0) + 1

    output: list[str] = []
    output.append("W022A TAB 1 HELP PARITY AUDIT")
    output.append("ROOT: " + str(ROOT))
    output.append("")
    output.append("SUMMARY")
    for key in ["COVERED", "PARTIAL", "IMPLEMENTED_NO_HELP_HIT", "HELP_ONLY", "MISSING"]:
        output.append("  " + key + ": " + str(counts.get(key, 0)))
    output.append("  implemented issue codes found: " + str(len(codes)))
    output.append("  help entries extracted: " + str(len(entries)))
    output.append("")
    output.append("PARITY ROWS")
    output.append("")

    for row in rows:
        output.append(row["id"] + " | " + row["status"] + " | " + row["label"])
        output.append("  mapped_codes: " + ", ".join(row["mapped_codes"]))
        output.append("  implemented_codes: " + (", ".join(row["implemented_codes"]) or "none"))
        help_hits = row["help_hits"]
        if help_hits:
            output.append("  help_hits:")
            for hit in help_hits:
                output.append("    - " + format_help_hit(hit))
        else:
            output.append("  help_hits: none")
        output.append("")

    output.append("IMPLEMENTED ISSUE CODES")
    for code in sorted(codes):
        output.append("  " + code)

    report_path = OUT_DIR / "w022a_tab1_help_parity_audit.txt"
    write_text(report_path, "\n".join(output) + "\n")
    return report_path


def write_help_entries(entries: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> Path:
    output: list[str] = []
    output.append("W022A EXTRACTED TAB 1 HELP ENTRIES")
    output.append("")

    for entry in entries:
        output.append(format_help_hit(entry))

    path = OUT_DIR / "w022a_extracted_tab1_help_entries.txt"
    write_text(path, "\n".join(output) + "\n")
    return path


def write_json(rows: list[dict[str, Any]], codes: set[str], entries: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> Path:
    payload = {
        "root": str(ROOT),
        "summary": {
            "implemented_issue_code_count": len(codes),
            "help_entry_count": len(entries),
        },
        "rows": rows,
        "implemented_issue_codes": sorted(codes),
    }
    path = OUT_DIR / "w022a_tab1_help_parity_audit.json"
    write_text(path, json.dumps(payload, indent=2) + "\n")
    return path


def main() -> int:
    OUT_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    source = load_manage_architecture_source()
    codes = implemented_issue_codes(source)
    files = iter_candidate_files()
    entries = extract_help_entries(files)
    rows = audit_expected(entries, codes)

    report_path = write_report(rows, codes, entries)
    entries_path = write_help_entries(entries)
    json_path = write_json(rows, codes, entries)

    print("W022A Tab 1 help parity audit complete.")
    print("WROTE " + str(report_path))
    print("WROTE " + str(entries_path))
    print("WROTE " + str(json_path))
    print("")
    print("COPY/PASTE THIS FILE FIRST:")
    print(str(report_path))
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

def read_text(path: Path) -> str:
    return path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")


def write_text(path: Path, text: str) -> None:
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")


def load_manage_architecture_source() -> str:
    root_text = str(ROOT)
    if root_text not in sys.path:
        sys.path.insert(0, root_text)

    module_name = (
        "kanda_reasoner_app.manage_architecture."
        "manage_architecture_help.source_loader_private_impl"
    )
    module = importlib.import_module(module_name)
    loader = getattr(module, "load_manage_architecture_source")
    return str(loader())


def implemented_issue_codes(source: str) -> set[str]:
    codes = set(VALIDATION_ISSUE_CODE_RE.findall(source))
    for code in ISSUE_CODE_RE.findall(source):
        if "_" not in code:
            continue
        if not code.isupper():
            continue
        if any(
            marker in code
            for marker in (
                "AI",
                "ARTIFACT",
                "BOUNDARY",
                "BUNDLE",
                "CIRCULAR",
                "CONFUSION",
                "CONTRACT",
                "CROSS",
                "DEAD",
                "DEPRECATED",
                "DUPLICATE",

                "MISSING",

                "PUBLIC",
                "SHADOW",
                "SIDE_EFFECT",
                "SOURCE_OF_TRUTH",
                "STALE",
                "SYMBOL",
                "TEST",
                "UNSAFE",
                "WRONG",
            )
        ):
            codes.add(code)
    return codes


def flatten_json(value: Any, path: str = "$") -> list[dict[str, str]]:
    rows: list[dict[str, str]] = []

    if isinstance(value, dict):
        for key, child in value.items():
            child_path = path + "." + str(key)
            rows.extend(flatten_json(child, child_path))
        return rows

    if isinstance(value, list):
        for index, child in enumerate(value):
            child_path = path + "[" + str(index) + "]"
            rows.extend(flatten_json(child, child_path))
        return rows

    if isinstance(value, str):
        rows.append({"path": path, "text": value})
        return rows

    if value is not None:
        rows.append({"path": path, "text": str(value)})
    return rows


def find_help_hits(flat_rows: list[dict[str, str]], keywords: list[str]) -> list[dict[str, str]]:
    lowered_keywords = [keyword.lower() for keyword in keywords]
    hits: list[dict[str, str]] = []
    for row in flat_rows:
        text = row["text"]
        lowered = text.lower()
        if any(keyword in lowered for keyword in lowered_keywords):
            hits.append(row)
    return hits


def find_stale_help_hits(flat_rows: list[dict[str, str]]) -> list[dict[str, str]]:
    stale_markers = [
        "not yet frozen",
        "not implemented",
        "not yet implemented",
        "not yet covered",
        "todo",
    ]
    return find_help_hits(flat_rows, stale_markers)


def audit(flat_rows: list[dict[str, str]], codes: set[str]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    rows: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    stale_rows = find_stale_help_hits(flat_rows)

    for item in TAB1_EXPECTED:
        implemented = [code for code in item["codes"] if code in codes]
        help_hits = find_help_hits(flat_rows, item["keywords"])

        stale_hits = []
        for hit in help_hits:
            hit_text = hit["text"].lower()
            if any(marker in hit_text for marker in ("not yet", "not implemented", "todo")):
                stale_hits.append(hit)

        status = "MISSING"
        if implemented and help_hits and not stale_hits:
            status = "COVERED"
        elif implemented and help_hits and stale_hits:
            status = "STALE_HELP_TEXT"
        elif implemented and not help_hits:
            status = "IMPLEMENTED_NO_HELP_HIT"
        elif not implemented and help_hits:
            status = "HELP_ONLY"

        rows.append(
            {
                "id": item["id"],
                "label": item["label"],
                "status": status,
                "mapped_codes": item["codes"],
                "implemented_codes": implemented,
                "help_hits": help_hits[:8],
                "stale_hits": stale_hits[:8],
            }
        )

    return rows

    counts: dict[str, int] = {}
    for row in rows:
        status = str(row["status"])
        counts[status] = counts.get(status, 0) + 1
    return {
        "counts": counts,
        "implemented_issue_code_count": len(codes),
        "flattened_help_string_count": len(flat_rows),
    }


def format_hit(hit: dict[str, str]) -> str:
    text = hit["text"].replace("\n", " ")
    if len(text) > 180:
        text = text[:177] + "..."
    return hit["path"] + " :: " + text


def write_report(rows: list[dict[str, Any]], summary: dict[str, Any]) -> Path:
    output: list[str] = []
    output.append("W022B TAB 1 JSON-AWARE HELP PARITY AUDIT")
    output.append("ROOT: " + str(ROOT))
    output.append("HELP: " + str(TAB1_HELP_PATH))
    output.append("")
    output.append("SUMMARY")
    for key in [
        "COVERED",
        "STALE_HELP_TEXT",
        "IMPLEMENTED_NO_HELP_HIT",
        "HELP_ONLY",
        "MISSING",
    ]:
        output.append("  " + key + ": " + str(summary["counts"].get(key, 0)))
    output.append("  implemented issue codes found: " + str(summary["implemented_issue_code_count"]))
    output.append("  flattened help strings: " + str(summary["flattened_help_string_count"]))
    output.append("")
    output.append("PARITY ROWS")
    output.append("")

    for row in rows:
        output.append(row["id"] + " | " + row["status"] + " | " + row["label"])
        output.append("  mapped_codes: " + ", ".join(row["mapped_codes"]))
        output.append("  implemented_codes: " + (", ".join(row["implemented_codes"]) or "none"))

        if row["help_hits"]:
            output.append("  help_hits:")
            for hit in row["help_hits"]:
                output.append("    - " + format_hit(hit))
        else:
            output.append("  help_hits: none")

        if row["stale_hits"]:
            output.append("  stale_hits:")
            for hit in row["stale_hits"]:
                output.append("    - " + format_hit(hit))
        output.append("")

    path = OUT_DIR / "w022b_tab1_json_help_parity_audit.txt"
    write_text(path, "\n".join(output) + "\n")
    return path


def write_json_report(rows: list[dict[str, Any]], summary: dict[str, Any]) -> Path:
    payload = {
        "root": str(ROOT),
        "help_path": str(TAB1_HELP_PATH),
        "summary": summary,
        "rows": rows,
    }
    path = OUT_DIR / "w022b_tab1_json_help_parity_audit.json"
    write_text(path, json.dumps(payload, indent=2) + "\n")
    return path


def main() -> int:
    OUT_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    if not TAB1_HELP_PATH.exists():
        print("MISSING TAB1 HELP FILE: " + str(TAB1_HELP_PATH))
        return 2

    source = load_manage_architecture_source()
    codes = implemented_issue_codes(source)
    help_payload = json.loads(read_text(TAB1_HELP_PATH))
    flat_rows = flatten_json(help_payload)

    rows = audit(flat_rows, codes)
    summary = make_summary(rows, codes, flat_rows)

    report_path = write_report(rows, summary)
    json_path = write_json_report(rows, summary)

    print("W022B Tab 1 JSON-aware parity audit complete.")
    print("WROTE " + str(report_path))
    print("WROTE " + str(json_path))
    print("")
    print("COPY/PASTE THIS FILE:")
    print(str(report_path))
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

@'
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import re
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(r"E:\developer_tools")
HELP_PATH = (
    ROOT
    / "kanda_reasoner_app"
    / "reasoner_tools_gui_help"
    / "tab1_architecture.json"
)

TARGETS = [
    {
        "number": 6,
        "error_index": 5,
        "error": "Side effect on import",
        "code": "SIDE_EFFECT_ON_IMPORT",
        "display_line": (
            "6. Side effect on import - A module performs visible work just by "
            "being imported. Imports should define names, not start actions, "
            "change folders, write files, or launch tools."
        ),
        "easy_example": (
            "Importing a helper module immediately opens a GUI window, changes "
            "the current directory, writes a file, or starts a subprocess."
        ),
    },
    {
        "number": 10,
        "error_index": 9,
        "error": "Test protection gap",
        "code": "TEST_PROTECTION_GAP",
        "display_line": (
            "10. Test protection gap - Important active source code has no "
            "direct or indirect test protection, so future changes can break it "
            "without the validation workflow noticing."
        ),
        "easy_example": (
            "A public workflow detector is used by Tab 2, but no focused test "
            "or workflow validation protects that detector behavior."
        ),
    },
    {
        "number": 17,
        "error_index": 16,
        "error": "Test asserts internal detail",
        "code": "TEST_ASSERTS_INTERNAL_DETAIL",
        "display_line": (
            "17. Test asserts internal detail - A test depends on private "
            "implementation details instead of public behavior, making safe "
            "refactors look broken."
        ),
        "easy_example": (
            "A test imports a private helper or checks a private variable name "
            "instead of validating the public command, issue code, or output."
        ),
    },
    {
        "number": 22,
        "error_index": 21,
        "error": "Shared mutable state coupling",
        "code": "SHARED_MUTABLE_STATE_COUPLING",
        "display_line": (
            "22. Shared mutable state coupling - Mutable state is shared across "
            "architecture boxes, so one box can silently change another box's "
            "runtime behavior."
        ),
        "easy_example": (
            "A global list or dictionary is imported and modified by multiple "
            "boxes instead of being passed through an explicit adapter or service."
        ),
    },
]


def read_text(path: Path) -> str:
    return path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")


def write_text(path: Path, text: str) -> None:
    path.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")


def update_display_line(payload: dict, number: int, new_text: str) -> None:
    lines = payload.get("display_lines")
    if not isinstance(lines, list):
        raise RuntimeError("tab1_architecture.json has no display_lines list.")

    pattern = re.compile(r"^\s*" + re.escape(str(number)) + r"\.")
    for index, line in enumerate(lines):
        if isinstance(line, str) and pattern.match(line):
            lines[index] = new_text
            return

    # Fallback to 1-based index when the line prefix was not found.
    fallback_index = number - 1
    if 0 <= fallback_index < len(lines):
        lines[fallback_index] = new_text
        return

    raise RuntimeError("Could not find display line number " + str(number))


def update_error_entry(payload: dict, target: dict) -> None:
    errors = payload.get("errors")
    if not isinstance(errors, list):
        raise RuntimeError("tab1_architecture.json has no errors list.")

    index = int(target["error_index"])
    if index < 0 or index >= len(errors):
        raise RuntimeError("Error index out of range: " + str(index))

    entry = errors[index]
    if not isinstance(entry, dict):
        raise RuntimeError("Error entry is not an object at index: " + str(index))

    entry["error"] = str(target["error"])
    entry["implemented_issue_code"] = str(target["code"])
    entry["parity_keywords"] = [
        str(target["error"]).lower(),
        str(target["code"]),
    ]

    if not entry.get("easy_example"):
        entry["easy_example"] = str(target["easy_example"])
    else:
        existing = str(entry.get("easy_example"))
        if str(target["error"]).lower() not in existing.lower():
            entry["easy_example"] = existing.rstrip() + " " + str(target["easy_example"])

    evidence = entry.get("evidence_to_check")
    if isinstance(evidence, list):
        if str(target["code"]) not in evidence:
            evidence.append(str(target["code"]))
    else:
        entry["evidence_to_check"] = [str(target["code"])]


def run_command(args: list[str]) -> None:
    print("RUN " + " ".join(args))
    completed = subprocess.run(args, cwd=str(ROOT), check=False)
    if completed.returncode != 0:
        raise SystemExit(completed.returncode)


def main() -> int:
    payload = json.loads(read_text(HELP_PATH))

    for target in TARGETS:
        update_display_line(payload, int(target["number"]), str(target["display_line"]))
        update_error_entry(payload, target)

    write_text(HELP_PATH, json.dumps(payload, indent=2) + "\n")

    run_command([sys.executable, "-m", "json.tool", str(HELP_PATH)])

    print("W022C Tab 1 help wording parity applied.")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import re
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(r"E:\developer_tools")
OUT_DIR = ROOT / "workbench" / "_bundle_temp" / "w023a_mixed_responsibility_audit"

VALIDATION_RE = re.compile(
    r"^WARNING\s+MIXED_RESPONSIBILITY_FILE\s+(.+?)\s+::\s+(.+)$"
)

KNOWN_INTENTIONAL_PATHS = {
    "kanda_reasoner_app/insert_missing_docstrings_gui/ai_docstring_generator.py",
    "kanda_reasoner_app/insert_missing_docstrings_gui/ai_docstring_generator_help/docstring_payloads.py",
    "kanda_reasoner_app/insert_missing_docstrings_gui/ai_docstring_generator_help/heuristics.py",
    "kanda_reasoner_app/insert_missing_docstrings_gui/docstring_validator.py",
    "kanda_reasoner_app/insert_missing_docstrings_gui/insert_missing_docstrings.py",
    "kanda_reasoner_app/insert_missing_docstrings_gui/insert_missing_docstrings_gui.py",
    "kanda_reasoner_app/insert_missing_docstrings_gui/insert_missing_docstrings_gui_help/ai_settings.py",
    "kanda_reasoner_app/insert_missing_docstrings_gui/insert_missing_docstrings_gui_help/dialogs.py",
    "kanda_reasoner_app/insert_missing_docstrings_gui/insert_missing_docstrings_gui_help/run_controls.py",
    "kanda_reasoner_app/insert_missing_docstrings_gui/insert_missing_docstrings_gui_help/window_state.py",
    "kanda_reasoner_app/insert_missing_docstrings_gui/insert_missing_docstrings_help/ast_safety.py",
    "kanda_reasoner_app/insert_missing_docstrings_gui/insert_missing_docstrings_help/cli.py",
    "kanda_reasoner_app/insert_missing_docstrings_gui/insert_missing_docstrings_help/file_processing.py",
    "kanda_reasoner_app/insert_missing_docstrings_gui/insert_missing_docstrings_help/heuristic_docstrings.py",
    "kanda_reasoner_app/insert_missing_docstrings_gui/insert_missing_docstrings_help/insertion_collector.py",
    "kanda_reasoner_app/insert_missing_docstrings_gui/insert_missing_docstrings_help/insertion_formatting.py",
    "kanda_reasoner_app/insert_missing_docstrings_gui/insert_missing_docstrings_help/reporting.py",
    "kanda_reasoner_app/insert_missing_docstrings_gui/insert_missing_docstrings_help/run_orchestrator.py",
    "kanda_reasoner_app/insert_missing_docstrings_gui/module_summarizer.py",
    "kanda_reasoner_app/manage_workflows/manage_workflows_gui.py",
    "kanda_reasoner_app/manage_workflows/manage_workflows_gui_help/workflow_gui_window.py",
    "kanda_reasoner_app/project_reasoner_v10/ai_reasoner_main_window.py",
    "kanda_reasoner_app/project_reasoner_v10/main_window_help/profile_controller.py",
    "kanda_reasoner_app/project_reasoner_v10/main_window_help/runtime_controller.py",
    "kanda_reasoner_app/project_reasoner_v10/reasoner_retriever.py",
    "kanda_reasoner_app/project_reasoner_v10/reasoner_retriever_help/query_intents.py",
    "kanda_reasoner_app/reasoner_context_collector/collector_runtime_scenarios.py",
    "kanda_reasoner_app/reasoner_context_collector/collector_runtime_scenarios_help/event_classification.py",
    "kanda_reasoner_app/reasoner_context_collector/collector_runtime_scenarios_help/hotspots.py",
    "kanda_reasoner_app/reasoner_runtime_collector/qt_hooks/qt_connection_monitor.py",
    "kanda_reasoner_app/reasoner_runtime_collector/runtime_runner.py",
    "kanda_reasoner_app/reasoner_tools_shell/runner.py",
}


def normalize(path_text: str) -> str:
    return path_text.strip().replace("\\", "/")


def run_validation() -> str:
    completed = subprocess.run(
        [
            sys.executable,
            "kanda_reasoner_app/manage_architecture/manage_architecture.py",
            "--root",
            str(ROOT),
            "--validate",
        ],
        cwd=str(ROOT),
        text=True,
        encoding="utf-8",
        errors="replace",
        stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
        stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
        check=False,
    )
    return completed.stdout


def box_for_path(path: str) -> str:
    if path.startswith("kanda_reasoner_app/insert_missing_docstrings_gui/"):
        return "docstring_tool"
    if path.startswith("kanda_reasoner_app/manage_workflows/"):
        return "workflow_governance"
    if path.startswith("kanda_reasoner_app/reasoner_context_collector/"):
        return "static_collector"
    if path.startswith("kanda_reasoner_app/reasoner_runtime_collector/"):
        return "runtime_collector"
    if path.startswith("kanda_reasoner_app/project_reasoner_v10/"):
        return "v10_reader_gui"
    if path.startswith("kanda_reasoner_app/reasoner_tools_shell/"):
        return "reasoner_tools_shell"
    return "unknown"


def classify(path: str) -> str:
    if path in KNOWN_INTENTIONAL_PATHS:
        return "KNOWN_RESIDUAL_ACCEPTED_OR_POLICY_FALSE_POSITIVE"
    return "NEEDS_SOURCE_REFACTOR_AUDIT"


def parse_warnings(output: str) -> list[dict[str, str]]:
    rows: list[dict[str, str]] = []
    for raw_line in output.splitlines():
        match = VALIDATION_RE.match(raw_line)
        if not match:
            continue
        path = normalize(match.group(1))
        message = match.group(2).strip()
        rows.append(
            {
                "path": path,
                "box": box_for_path(path),
                "classification": classify(path),
                "message": message,
            }
        )
    return rows


def write_report(rows: list[dict[str, str]], raw_output: str) -> None:
    OUT_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    counts_by_box: dict[str, int] = {}
    counts_by_class: dict[str, int] = {}
    for row in rows:
        counts_by_box[row["box"]] = counts_by_box.get(row["box"], 0) + 1
        counts_by_class[row["classification"]] = counts_by_class.get(row["classification"], 0) + 1

    report: list[str] = []
    report.append("W023A MIXED_RESPONSIBILITY_FILE AUDIT")
    report.append("ROOT: " + str(ROOT))
    report.append("")
    report.append("SUMMARY")
    report.append("  total_mixed_responsibility_warnings: " + str(len(rows)))
    report.append("")
    report.append("BY BOX")
    for key in sorted(counts_by_box):
        report.append("  " + key + ": " + str(counts_by_box[key]))
    report.append("")
    report.append("BY CLASSIFICATION")
    for key in sorted(counts_by_class):
        report.append("  " + key + ": " + str(counts_by_class[key]))
    report.append("")
    report.append("ROWS")
    for index, row in enumerate(rows, start=1):
        report.append("")
        report.append(str(index).rjust(2) + ". " + row["path"])
        report.append("    box: " + row["box"])
        report.append("    classification: " + row["classification"])
        report.append("    message: " + row["message"])

    report_path = OUT_DIR / "w023a_mixed_responsibility_audit.txt"
    report_path.write_text("\n".join(report) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")

    json_path = OUT_DIR / "w023a_mixed_responsibility_audit.json"
